cardOverview.overviewText: An ePay card tailored for digital-first customers, offering rewards on online transactions, utility payments, and recharges.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accident cover up to ₹1 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, email rupay@newindia.co.in within 30 days of the incident. Ensure to submit all required documents within 60 days of reporting the claim

benefitRows.name: Priority Pass
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit the Priority Pass activation page. Enter your membership number and validation code. If required, provide the last four digits of your payment card associated with the membership
